description: Rows written before columns are dropped: drop the middle variable column Alt.B; drop the final variable column Alt.D; update an old row's Alt.A to a longer value; insert a new row. Asks what the old rows' bytes look like after each schema or row step, and what the public projection returns. Images: 'before' (the fixture copy as given), then one kept image of the closed file after each step; every step opens the database read/write, makes one mutation and closes it.
retentionNote: Designed r-fmt-2-pres-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
